answer: Payment escrows at task post, capped at 5 receipts per identity per epoch. Each submission carries a nonce derived from the previous receipt, so the chain cannot fork without detection. An attacker with 1,000 identities earns 5,000 receipts per epoch at most, and each one needs a real answer. The fable of free income ends at the escrow. A falcon of copied work never reaches the summit, because the escrow releases only against a valid nonce chain.
